selected_evidence.requirement: Key-based SSH authentication is required (password/interactive auth disabled)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed no conflicting settings existed, added an sshd_config.d drop-in enforcing PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes / KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, validated with sshd -t, reloaded sshd, and confirmed via sshd -T both before and after the restart that the effective config disables password/kbd-interactive auth while keeping pubkey auth enabled. No active Match blocks override this.

selected_evidence.requirement: opsadmin account itself is restricted to key-based login (no usable password)
selected_evidence.summary: Locked opsadmin's password (passwd -l); shadow entry shows '!!' before and after the restart, confirming no password-based login is possible for this account.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory single-node restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (31b01b46-...) plus healthy sshd/opsadmin state, issued a deferred systemctl reboot whose ack returned before disconnection, observed the node drop and come back with a new boot_id (8fbebb86-...) proving an actual restart, and confirmed sshd active plus opsadmin/key-only SSH configuration fully recovered afterward.
